name: volc-agent-launchpad
description: Transactional Agent middleware built on the CodeJam starter kit and ModelArk.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @launchpad/server" "npm run dev -w @launchpad/web"
scripts.prebuild: npm run build -w @agent-airlock/transactional-resource-sdk && npm run build -w @agent-airlock/http-object-resource && npm run build -w @agent-airlock/portable-promotion-receipt
scripts.build: npm run build -w @launchpad/web && npm run build -w @launchpad/server
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build -w @agent-airlock/transactional-resource-sdk && npm run build -w @agent-airlock/http-object-resource && npm run build -w @agent-airlock/portable-promotion-receipt
scripts.check: npm run check:scripts && npm run typecheck && npm run test:modelark-evidence && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check:scripts: node --check scripts/run-local-poc.mjs scripts/run-modelark-demo.mjs scripts/modelark-demo-profile.mjs scripts/modelark-conformance-evidence.mjs scripts/modelark-recorded-evidence.mjs scripts/modelark-live-proof-runner.mjs scripts/prove-modelark-live.mjs scripts/verify-modelark-evidence.mjs scripts/judge-readiness.mjs scripts/judge-readiness.test.mjs scripts/check-modelark-live.mjs scripts/check-modelark-live.test.mjs scripts/poc-doctor.mjs scripts/poc-doctor.test.mjs scripts/check-container-transaction.mjs scripts/run-container-browser-fixture.mjs scripts/check-phase-thirteen.mjs scripts/run-demo.mjs scripts/run-phase-eight-demo.mjs scripts/run-phase-nine-demo.mjs scripts/run-phase-ten-demo.mjs scripts/run-phase-eleven-demo.mjs scripts/check-phase-eight-clean-clone.mjs scripts/check-clean-clone-layout.test.mjs scripts/check-phase-eight-boundaries.mjs scripts/check-phase-nine-boundaries.mjs scripts/check-phase-eleven-protocol.mjs scripts/check-docker-workspace-layout.mjs scripts/check-phase-eight-contract.test.mjs scripts/run-demo.test.mjs scripts/release-audit.mjs tests/fixtures/fake-codex.mjs tests/fixtures/responses-protocol-server.mjs tests/fixtures/start-baseline-server.mjs && node scripts/check-docker-workspace-layout.mjs && bash -n scripts/start-local-poc.sh scripts/probe-codex-session.sh scripts/probe-codex-protocol.sh scripts/check-infrastructure.sh scripts/check-phase-eleven-docker.sh && node --test scripts/run-local-poc.test.mjs scripts/modelark-demo-profile.test.mjs scripts/modelark-conformance-evidence.test.mjs scripts/modelark-live-proof-runner.test.mjs scripts/judge-readiness.test.mjs scripts/check-modelark-live.test.mjs scripts/poc-doctor.test.mjs scripts/check-clean-clone-layout.test.mjs
scripts.check:phase0: npm run check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check:phase2: npm run check && npm run test:e2e && npm audit
scripts.check:phase3: npm run check:phase2 && npm run test:codex-session-container && npm run test:validation-container
scripts.check:phase7: npm run check:phase6 && npm run test:demo && npm run test:demo:e2e && npm run check:infra && npm run audit:release
scripts.check:phase8:sdk: npm run typecheck -w @agent-airlock/transactional-resource-sdk && npm run test -w @agent-airlock/transactional-resource-sdk && npm run build -w @agent-airlock/transactional-resource-sdk && tsc -p tests/sdk-consumer/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check:phase8:provider: npm run typecheck -w @agent-airlock/http-object-resource && npm run test -w @agent-airlock/http-object-resource
scripts.check:phase8:conformance: npm run build -w @agent-airlock/transactional-resource-sdk && npm run build -w @agent-airlock/http-object-resource && node packages/transactional-resource-sdk/dist/cli.js @agent-airlock/http-object-resource/conformance-fixture
scripts.check:phase8:boundaries: npm run build -w @agent-airlock/transactional-resource-sdk && npm run build -w @agent-airlock/http-object-resource && node scripts/check-phase-eight-boundaries.mjs && node --test scripts/check-phase-eight-contract.test.mjs
scripts.check:phase8:core: npm run check:phase7 && npm run check:phase8:sdk && npm run check:phase8:conformance && npm run check:phase8:provider && npm run check:phase8:boundaries && npm run test:phase8:ui && npm run test:phase8:e2e
scripts.check:phase8: npm run check:phase8:core && npm run check:phase8:clean-clone
scripts.check:phase9:selection: npm test -w @launchpad/server -- --run src/candidate-selection.test.ts src/candidate-set.test.ts src/phase-nine-acceptance.test.ts src/store.test.ts
scripts.check:phase9:core: npm run check:phase8:core && npm run check:phase9:selection && npm run check:phase9:boundaries && npm run test:phase9:ui
scripts.check:phase9: npm run check:phase9:core && npm run check:phase9:clean-clone
scripts.check:phase10:core: npm run check:phase9:core && npm run check:phase10:assurance && npm run test:phase10:ui
scripts.check:phase10: npm run check:phase10:core && npm run check:phase10:clean-clone
scripts.check:phase11:protocol: npm run typecheck -w @agent-airlock/portable-promotion-receipt && npm run test -w @agent-airlock/portable-promotion-receipt && npm run build -w @agent-airlock/portable-promotion-receipt && node scripts/check-phase-eleven-protocol.mjs
scripts.check:phase11:docker: bash scripts/check-phase-eleven-docker.sh && npm run test:container-transaction && npm run test:container-browser
scripts.check:phase11:core: npm run check:phase10:core && npm run check:phase11:protocol && npm run check:phase11:trust && npm run test:phase11:ui
scripts.check:phase11: npm run check:phase11:core && npm run check:phase11:docker && npm run check:phase11:clean-clone
scripts.check:phase12: npm run check && npm run test:phase12:real
scripts.check:phase13: npm run check && npm run test:phase11:ui:mock && npm run test:phase12:real && npm run check:phase13:runtime && npm run audit:release
scripts.test:phase11:ui: npm run test:phase11:ui:mock && npm run test:phase11:ui:real
